notes.title: Last chance to play the demo!
notes.notes:
Heads-up, Fellow Vikings!

We wanted to let you know that we’ll be taking down the current demo on April 22 (Central European Time). While we’re proud of what the demo showed at the time, the game has evolved—and we feel it no longer fully represents the experience we’re building.

That said, we’re keeping the demo up over the weekend for anyone who wants to give it a final spin before it disappears.

A new and improved demo will return closer to release. That is more true to the full game we’re crafting. We’re incredibly grateful for all the feedback and support so far. Thank you for sailng this journey with us.

Skål,
Oddiko Team

notes.title: Welcome to Meadgard!
notes.notes:
[b]WELCOME TO MEADGARD![/b]

Hey fellow Vikings!
Buckle up for story time, we got a really exciting announcement for you all!

During our two years of development we have managed to put together some great ideas on how to expand the game, but budgets and insecurities have always held us back from any of those ideas in the end. After multiple unsuccessful pitches and the team eventually becoming utterly and completely broke, we made a “go big or go home” decision in January this year to go for it and scale up the project with our ideas.
So after a mental breakdown, a couple of design meetings, an awfully performed pitch in Stockholm and finally with some funding in our pockets, we are happy to announce that our dreams for this game will come through and we are now making an even bigger game! We are also saying goodbye to the name Beer and Plunder and hello to Meadgard!

The new design in Meadgard is built upon what all of you have already come to love about Beer and Plunder, and adds to that, features and designs to let you and your friends venture and explore outside the Tavern as well.
In short, you are still serving your hot-headed customers during the night just like before, but you now need to gather ingredients and resources outside the tavern during the day in order to do so! You also get to meet a cast of quirky and mysterious characters looking to set up shop inside your village. Build, craft, plant and brew with the help of your villagers and unravel a wacky and engaging story through their quests.
Oh, have I mentioned that you will be able to play with your friends online? Because you certainly will (thank you money people)!

[b]Listed features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Team up with your friends and become the best viking innkeepers in the nine realms.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Explore a mythical island filled with hidden treasures, bountiful resources and dangerous creatures.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Use different weapons to fight creatures and gather unique ingredients.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Unlock new recipes and serve your customers at the Tavern before they lose their temper.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Craft, farm, brew and build in your town.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Unravel a chaotic and wacky story packed with norse gods and mythological creatures.
[/list]

Huge thank you to all our players out there, we hope you are as excited for Meadgard as we are at Oddiko. Stay updated and follow us on social media @OddikoGames, and join our discord community to engage with the developers, leave feedback and connect with other players around the world https://discord.gg/UrW4jM9F.

Cheers and Skål!
/ The Oddiko Team

notes.title: We now have a demo!
notes.notes:
Hi fellow Vikings! Have you had the chance to play our demo yet? It's a significant milestone for us, and we're thrilled to finally showcase what we've been working on!


We've been attentively listening to your feedback, and now it's possible to play alone. However, it's not recommended since the game isn't balanced for a single player. The good news is that it's incredibly easy to invite your Steam friends to join you using the Steam Remote Play function.
